title: Arban – Major Scales No. 42, in C♯ major

details.title: Arban – Major Scales No. 42, in C♯ major
details.lead: From Arban's Grande méthode complète de cornet à pistons et de saxhorn, first edition, 1864. The notes are the cornet part as printed, in written pitch for the B♭ cornet. Below: the book's own words, translated from the French.
facts: Arban, Grande méthode complète de cornet à pistons et de saxhorn, first edition (Paris: Léon Escudier, 1864)
The book prints this study twice, braced together: in D♭ major and, below it, in C♯ major, the same notes on the valves. This is the lower line.

sections.heading: Major scales
paragraphs: The study of scales has always been much neglected in works of this kind. Most of them give a few examples and leave the pupil to find in himself whatever the method leaves out. What comes of it? Very few artists know how to play a scale correctly.

Yet scales must be worked at, and worked at steadily. Knowing how much this kind of study matters, I have treated this part at great length, and in every key. This work gives a perfectly even sound, and playing that is smooth and correct.
